reason: Two related bugs found and fixed. (1) The treemap (card 74681, Candidates Added by Source) had been wired to reuse drill-down card 75524, which was built from a DIFFERENT card (74685) construction that includes a Latest Candidate Stage Model join the treemap itself does not have — built a dedicated drill-down (75534) from the treemap own dataset_query instead and rewired the treemap click_behavior to target it. (2) While verifying, discovered the group-by-all-displayed-columns dedup approach from the prior fix could silently collapse two DIFFERENT candidates into one row whenever their displayed columns (name, source, etc.) happened to match (confirmed: two different Francisco Rodriguez candidates on the Referral source collapsed 514->513) - undercounting rather than removing noise. Fixed all 11 drill-down cards (10 funnel drill-downs + the new treemap one) by adding the candidate id field to the breakout/group-by set, and fixed an unrelated silent day-level truncation of hiring_stage_date/job_created_on caused by MBQL default temporal bucketing on breakout, using temporal-unit: default to preserve full precision.
verification_notes: Unqualified (75525) for Indeed now matches the report exactly (1003=1003) after the id fix, versus 1004 before (undercounted-then-overcounted via the earlier buggy dedup). Treemap drill-down (75534) matches the treemap own true aggregate exactly for both Referral (514) and Indeed (2672).

Added entity profile links to every Sourcing Report drill-down column that shows a candidate/job/company name, per updated CLAUDE.md rule. Candidate profile is a sibling column on the same Candidates table (no new join needed). Job and company profile required new left joins to the Jobs and Companies tables, joined on the join_for_jobs_table / join_for_companies_table FK columns already exposed by the Latest Candidate Stage Model (never joined on the text name). Plain name columns hidden (table.columns enabled:false), profile columns shown instead with view_as: link, link_text: {{name column}}, and column_title renamed to "<Entity> Name" - mirroring the user-provided example on card 75524.
verification_notes: Row counts for the Indeed slice on every card matched the previously-verified id-inclusive breakout counts exactly (the new Jobs/Companies joins are 1:1 on unique ids, so no fanout) - e.g. 75525 stayed at 1003, 75526 at 231, etc. Spot-checked actual candidate_profile/job_profile/company_profile URL values on populated rows.

reason: The pivot breaks out by job_name, Source - Category, AND company_name (3 dimensions), but its 8 per-metric column click_behaviors only passed job_name + Source - Category (+ the Date filter) - company_name was missing, violating the drill-down rule that every dimension a chart groups by must be passed through. Added a company_name column-source mapping (targeting the same Latest Candidate Stage Model join-alias field used by job_name) to all 8 metric column click_behaviors (Uncontacted, Prescreen, Assigned, Contacted, Hired, Attrition, Candidate Verification, Client Submission).
note: In this accounts current data every named job_name maps to exactly one company_name, so this gap did not produce a visibly wrong count for any spot-checked cell (e.g. Hired for job=195 - Journeyman Electrician / Indeed matched exactly: 9=9) - the fix is a correctness/completeness fix per the documented rule, not a response to an observed wrong number.

reason: Two gaps fixed per updated CLAUDE.md rules. (1) The dashboard Date filter is passed into every Sourcing Report drill-down as an ad-hoc filter on created_on (via the funnel table/treemap) or job_created_on (via the pivot, already shown) - but created_on itself was never displayed as a column on any of the 11 drill-downs, so a viewer had no visibility into the actual date value driving the filter. Added created_on (titled "Date Added") to all 11 cards. (2) The drill-downs showed only what was strictly needed for the metric/dimensions, with no independently-actionable context - added email (titled "Email") to all 11 cards so the candidate list is usable without a separate lookup.
verification_notes: Row counts for the Indeed/Referral verification slices matched the pre-fix values exactly on every card (created_on and email are 1:1 per candidate, no fanout risk). Spot-checked actual created_on/email values populate correctly.
